conclusion.original: Fix a positive horizon and nested regular dyadic grids at levels m and n with m≤n. Assign each coarse cell a real weight and each fine cell a real value. The fine sum weighted by the enclosing coarse cell equals the weighted sum of consecutive differences of the fine prefix sums at coarse grid points. Formula: \sum_i w_{c(i)}z_i=\sum_jw_j\bigl(P(s_{j+1})-P(s_j)\bigr),\qquad P(a)=\sum_{i:\ t_{i+1}\le a}z_i.
conclusion.reconstructed: For k=0,...,2^m put P_k=∑_{i=0}^{2^n-1}1_{t_{i+1}≤s_k} z_i. With c(i) the supplied coarseCell(m≤n,i), ∑_{i=0}^{2^n-1}w_{c(i)} z_i = ∑_{j=0}^{2^m-1}w_j(P_{j+1}-P_j). The refinement factor is 2^(n-m), and c(i)=floor(i/2^(n-m)) using natural-number division.
